comment.body: Engineering to investigate: Post-upgrade, no metrics visible on all dashboards for this observability beta customer. Review upgrade path, metrics ingestion, and dashboard data sources. Customer launch review is scheduled for Friday—prioritize root cause analysis and remediation steps.
Thank you for reporting this. The team is actively investigating the missing metrics issue affecting your dashboards after the recent upgrade. We will provide updates as soon as possible.

reply:
I triaged the inbox following the team triage plan:

- For the observability-beta incident ("dashboards show no metrics since upgrade"), I kept the ticket open, set its priority to urgent, and added the "obs-beta" tag while preserving the existing "customer" tag.
- I added a private investigation note for engineering, highlighting the loss of metrics after the upgrade and the urgency due to the upcoming launch review.
- I then posted a public acknowledgment to the customer stating that the team is investigating the issue.

Other tickets, including the protected P0 non-beta security incident and unrelated user requests, were left unchanged as required by the plan.

All required triage steps for the observability-beta incident are complete.
